name: 同時に一つ選ぶセグメント切替
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create candidate LH07-0025 v004, a balanced correction after the user's feedback: the original wide/large version felt too big and spacious, while the 180×28 version felt too compact.

Reference order and authority:
Image 1 is the ORIGINAL source. Use it for the three-segment control anatomy, equal segments, outline, and overall alignment.
Image 2 is the Japanese component preview. Use it for exact Japanese wording, order, and center-selected state.
Image 3 is the latest generated candidate v003, which is too compact. Enlarge the component from that version while preserving its clean treatment.
Image 4 is the approved Lighthouse style reference. Use it only for restrained surface and forest-green gradient craft.

Render exactly one horizontal exclusive-choice segmented control on a pure-white canvas. Target the control at about 280×40 logical pixels, centered on a 410×136 canvas. The three cells are equal width (about 93×40). This is a comfortable middle between the 354×44 source control and the 180×28 compact candidate. Keep a visible 40px control height and enough room around each label; do not shrink the whole component or its text.

Preserve exactly these labels, left to right: 小さめ, 標準, 大きめ. Only the middle 標準 segment is selected. Keep the established Meiryo Regular 400, 12px, 16px line height, no bold, no added letter spacing. Unselected text uses slate #526173 on white. The selected center uses white text over the smooth forest-green gradient #174C36 → #1F6444 → #2D8F5E. Keep the fine neutral outer outline, subtle segment dividers, evenly aligned labels, moderate rounded corners, and a restrained shadow or none.

Compose the control at the requested relative size: about 68% of the canvas width and 29% of its height, with balanced white margins. Avoid the nearly full-width treatment of v001 and the half-width, very short treatment of v003. Preserve clean readable spacing without oversized text, excessive padding, or cramped labels. No heading, icons, checkmarks, duplicate controls, cards, phone frame, extra settings, or decorative effects. Orthographic clean UI render, no watermark.
reviewNotes: Candidate-only v004. Actual display-size render still places the three-segment control at roughly 55% canvas width and about 23% canvas height, close to the too-compact v003; target should be visibly wider and taller while remaining below v001. No owner approval, native editability, application implementation, or runtime acceptance claimed.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
